title: Predator packs
summary: Packs come from nests on a timer, bigger at night. Turrets and units hold them off.
text:
The planet's predators come in **packs** from their nests. The threat counter (⚠) says when the next one is due; packs that arrive at night are bigger.

- Build **Turrets** on the side the packs come from, with power to run them
- Combat units from a Vehicle Bay can go after a pack, or a nest
- A destroyed nest sends no packs until it grows back

If the Command Core falls, the colony is lost.
